verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Shortcut pulling assigned tasks from other project management tools into one unified view. What it documents instead is one-time migration (Jira and Trello import, CSV), a general API for building custom integrations, and tracking work inside Shortcut itself. Those are adjacent features or developer building blocks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view
